MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 31

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

6. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 64

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 11

17. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 9

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 22

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

5. c = 41
